decision_rationale: The paper presents SeqVec as protein sequence embeddings learned with ELMo on unlabeled UniRef50, which is foundation-model-like pretraining. The abstract does not explicitly state a generative decoding or sequence-generation mechanism, so generative status is not clear.
evidence_snippet: "using the language model ELMo"; "trained ELMo on UniRef50"; "captured ... from unlabeled big data"; "transfer-learning" used for downstream prediction tasks
